issues.originalQuote: Tests will check the supplied examples, but passing them will not be presented as proof that a program is correct for every input [S1].
issues.revisedQuote: While tests will verify the supplied examples, passing them does not guarantee the program's correctness for all inputs [S1].
issues.problem: The candidate preserves the limitation of testing but omits the explicit commitment not to present passing tests as proof of correctness for every input.

audit.reason: The candidate otherwise preserves the substantive design, comparisons, evaluation measures, limitations, attribution, developer authority and planned-work status. Its readability is comparable, with some wordier phrasing.
